t: Reported Arrival In Shanghai Of Wong Ping, An Alleged Important Member Of The Trotsky Clique

pages.en:
ICC
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
S.I, Special Branch.
REPORT
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
FILE NO: REGISTRY
No. S. B. D. 7297
18 . 2 . 37
Date February 17 . 1937
Subject Reported arrival in Shanghai of Wong Ping ( 黄平 ), an alleged
important member of the Trotsky Clique.
Made by D.I. Kuh Pao Hwa Forwarded by I Bayne D S I
With reference to the attached newspaper translation bear-
ing on the above subject, I have to state that diligent enquiries
made through various sources by the Chinese staff of Section I
have so far failed to obtain any confirmation of the report.
The local Chinese and Japanese authorities upon being confidential-
ly approached are likewise unable to cast any light on the subject.
It is absurd to state that Wong Ping's activities resulted
in the formation of the Shanghai City Students National Salvation
Association on October 15, 1936, and the publication of an
official paper entitled the "Struggle", because it is generally
known that the local National Salvation movement was originally
fostered by the Social Democratic Party and that the "Struggle"
was once an organ of the Stalin Clique.
Although the name Wong Ping does not appear among the
records of the Special Branch, it has been added to our iden-
tification cards for future reference.
Kuh Pao hwa
D. I.
D.C. (Special Branch).
（印：17 FEB. 1937）
pages.zh:
工部局
上海公共租界工部局警务处
S.I，特务科。
报告
上海公共租界工部局警务处
档案号：登记处
编号 S. B. D. 7297
18 . 2 . 37
日期 1937年2月17日
事由 据报托派（Trotsky Clique） alleged 重要成员黄平（Wong Ping）抵达上海。
呈报人 侦探长 顾宝华（Kuh Pao Hwa） 转呈人 I Bayne 副侦探长
关于随附的涉及上述事由的报纸译文，本人须说明，第一科华籍职员通过各种渠道进行的勤勉调查，迄今未能获得任何对该报告的证实。
经秘密接洽，当地中国和日本当局同样无法就此事项提供任何线索。
声称黄平的活动导致了1936年10月15日上海市学生救国会的成立以及名为《斗争》的官方刊物的出版，这种说法是荒谬的，因为众所周知，当地的救国运动最初是由社会民主党（Social Democratic Party）所扶植，而《斗争》曾是斯大林派（Stalin Clique）的机关刊物。
尽管特务科的记录中未出现黄平之名，但已将其加入我们的身份识别卡片中，以备将来查考。
顾宝华
侦探长
副侦探长（特务科）。
（印：1937年2月17日）

pages.en:
NIPPO 29-1-37 (mm)

WONG PING SECRETLY ENTERS SHANGHAI

It is reported that the Trotsky
Party in North China, which is anti-Japanese, anti-Stalin
and anti-Nanking, has sent to Shanghai a man named Wong
Ping, an important member of the party, to secure more
comrades and to promote party affairs.
Wong Ping's activities resulted
in the formation of the Shanghai City Students National
Salvation Association on October 15, 1936 and the
publication of an official paper called the "Struggle".
This paper is being distributed among newspapers, schools
and labourers. The party and the students national
salvation association had planned to distribute inflammatory
handbills and create disturbances in Chapei on January 28
but their plan was frustrated by the precautionary measures
adopted by the Police Bureau.

S.I. inquiries
SOR

《日日新闻》 1937年1月29日 (mm)

黄平秘密进入上海

据报道，华北反日、反斯大林且反南京政府的托洛茨基党（Trotsky Party）已派遣该党重要成员一名叫黄平的人前往上海，以吸纳更多同志并推进党务。
黄平的活动导致了1936年10月15日上海市学生救国会的成立以及名为《斗争》的官方刊物的出版。
该刊物正在报纸界、学校及劳工中分发。该党和学生救国会曾计划于1月28日在闸北散发煽动性传单并制造骚乱，但其计划因警察局采取的预防措施而受挫。

S.I. 查询
